The plate is a square, roughly 22-24 cm across, so it is probably a side or dinner plate. On it are scrambled eggs and pineapple chunks.

**Scrambled eggs:** the pile is about 9 cm by 8 cm and about 2.5 cm high, which I estimate at roughly 100 g. Scrambled eggs run about 150-200 kcal per 100 g once the cooking fat is counted, so I use about 170 kcal.

**Pineapple:** there are about 11 chunks, each about 10-15 g, so roughly 130 g. At about 50 kcal per 100 g that is about 65 kcal.

**Total:** about 230 g of food and about 235 kcal.
